Short notes / call highlights:
- Very price sensitive; small district + 25 schools initially. They emphasized predictability: 'we can't have surprise bills'.
- Primary workloads: classroom copilot (summaries, hint generation), auto-quiz generation from lesson plans, student message moderation (flagging profanity/bullying).
- Preference for hosted self-serve to get started (no infra). Will consider Dedicated later if usage grows.
- Want pre-built moderation configs + examples for school scenarios. Asked about offline/air-gapped options but said too expensive for now.
- SE check: can we provide suggested batching to stay under $X/token for auto-quiz flow? Need recommended model + quant/size tradeoff guidance.
- Quote from lead teacher: 'If it’s easy to plug into Google Classroom and stays cheap, we can pilot quickly.'
- Risk: procurement requires one school district champion to sign; budget cycle is mid-April.
- AE notes: follow-up with pricing deck + two short integration samples (Node + Python) and a sample moderation policy template.
- Suggested POC metrics: false-positive rate on moderation < 5%, avg chat latency < 800ms 95th pct, cost per generated quiz < $0.50/quiz (target).
